title: MyLinden Help: Debit Credit on a Re-Spread Patient Payment Plans Installment
content:
**Is there a credit for automatic debit when my Patient Payment Plans installment is re-spread?**

The debit credit on the re-spread installment is 1.50 when the plan's automatic debit method is card or HSA/FSA card and your Patient Financial Account keeps a card on file; 1.00 when the method is ACH and the account keeps a card on file; and 0.00 in every other case.

**How is it applied?** The credit is subtracted from the spread of the plan balance; the re-spread installment is never below the tier's minimum installment and is rounded half up to the cent.

**Which records decide it?** The automatic debit method recorded on the plan and whether the Patient Financial Account keeps a card on file.

| Automatic debit method on the plan | Card on file on the Patient Financial Account | Debit credit (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Card or HSA/FSA card | Yes | 1.50 |
| ACH | Yes | 1.00 |
| Card, HSA/FSA card or ACH | No | 0.00 |
| None | Either | 0.00 |

**Example (hypothetical).** A spread of 201.56 on a plan paying by ACH, with a card on file: 201.56 less 1.00 is 200.56.
